add.census_name: rocksdb::BlockBuilder::Add(rocksdb::Slice const&, rocksdb::Slice const&, rocksdb::Slice const*)

hash.census_name: rocksdb::Hash(char const*, unsigned long, unsigned int)

hash_reset.census_name: DataBlockHashIndexBuilder annex reset helper (no vendor-census record at this address; named by this packet)

trailer.census_name: block trailer word helper (no vendor-census record at this address; named by this packet)

builder.add_rule: Add(key, value, value_delta*): if counter >= restart_interval, push (uint32)buffer.size onto restarts, add 4 to the estimate field, set counter to 0 and shared to 0; else when use_delta_encoding is set, shared is the longest common prefix of last_key and key. Header: varint32(shared) and varint32(non_shared = key.size - shared), plus varint32((uint32)value.size) only when use_value_delta_encoding is off. Then key[shared:] is appended, then the value bytes: the full value, except when use_value_delta_encoding is on and shared > 0, when the caller-supplied value_delta slice is appended verbatim instead (its data pointer and size are read with no null check). When the annex is enabled, the annex Add is called first with the key minus its last 8 bytes (the internal-key tag) and restart_index = len(restarts) - 1. Finally counter increments, the estimate field grows by the number of bytes this call appended, and when use_delta_encoding is set last_key is replaced by key. Every append goes through the string append path that throws std::length_error ("basic_string::append") when the remaining capacity is smaller than the piece.
builder.annex_add_rule: DataBlockHashIndexBuilder::Add(user_key, restart_index): when restart_index > 0xfd (253) the body sets enabled to 0 and records nothing; this disable is sticky, because Reset reaches the annex reset helper only while enabled is still set. Otherwise it appends the record {Hash(user_key, 0x18d), (uint8)restart_index} and adds the increment to the accumulator by repeated addition (six additions of 4/3 give 7.999999999999999, not 8.0).
builder.annex_finish_rule: DataBlockHashIndexBuilder::Finish(out): builds a byte array of num_buckets bytes initialised to 0xff; for each entry in order, slot = hash % num_buckets: an empty slot takes the entry's restart_index byte, a slot already holding that byte keeps it, and a slot holding a different byte is demoted to 0xfe. The array is appended to out, followed by num_buckets as little-endian uint16.
builder.ctor_rule: BlockBuilder(restart_interval, use_delta, use_value_delta, index_type, ratio): stores the three leading arguments at +0x00/+0x04/+0x05, initialises restarts to [0] and the estimate field to 8, counter and finished to 0, and fixes the annex increment: -1.0 when index_type != 1; for index_type == 1, 1.0/ratio when ratio > 0, 4/3 when ratio <= 0, and NaN when ratio is NaN (the NaN case takes the division path). The 4/3 constant is the double at 0x459260, 1.0 at 0x4592b0, -1.0 at 0x451110.
builder.estimate_rule: EstimateSizeAfterKV(key, value) is an estimator, not an exact size: estimate_field + key.size + (num_buckets + 2 when the annex is enabled) + a value term + a header allowance. The value term is value.size, halved (value >> 1) only in the delta, non-restart case. The header allowance is: 8 + varint32len(key.size) + varint32len(value.size) when a restart is imminent (counter + 1 >= restart_interval); otherwise 4 + varint32len(key.size) + varint32len(value.size) when delta encoding is off; otherwise 4 + varint32len(key.size), plus varint32len(value.size) as well unless the stored use_value_delta_encoding byte is exactly 1.
builder.finish_rule: Finish(): appends every restart offset as little-endian uint32 to the buffer; then, only when the annex is enabled and estimate_field + num_buckets + 2 <= 0x10000, appends the annex block (bucket bytes plus little-endian uint16 num_buckets) via the annex Finish; then stores the trailer word num_restarts with the top bit 0x80000000 set exactly when the annex block was appended (the trailer helper sets the bit only for flag == 1); sets finished to 1. The Finish body itself contains no finished_ guard: calling it twice appends the restart array and trailer again.
builder.hash_rule: rocksdb::Hash(data, len, seed): m = 0xc6a4a793; h = seed ^ ((uint32)len * m); each full 4-byte group: h = (h + LE32(group)) * m, then h ^= h >> 16; the tail bytes are added sign-extended (movsx from int8): a 3-byte tail adds s8(b2) << 16, then s8(b1) << 8, then s8(b0), a 2-byte tail the last two, a 1-byte tail the last one; the final mix h *= m, h ^= h >> 24 runs only when the tail length is nonzero, so a multiple-of-4 input skips it. All arithmetic is uint32.

layout.annex_entries: this +0x88 (std::vector of 8-byte records {uint32 hash, uint8 restart_index, 3 pad bytes})
layout.annex_increment: this +0x70 (double): per-entry bucket increment fixed at construction
layout.counter: this +0x48 (int32): entries since the last restart
layout.estimate_field: this +0x40 (uint64): the bodies keep it equal to buffer.size + 4*len(restarts) + 4

builder.num_buckets_rule: num_buckets = (uint16)((int32)accumulator | 1), computed identically at the Finish gate, in the annex Finish and in EstimateSizeAfterKV; the double-to-int32 conversion is cvttsd2si, so a NaN or out-of-range accumulator converts to 0x80000000 and yields 1 bucket.

builder.reset_rule: Reset(): clears the buffer, truncates restarts to one element (growing it back to one via the helper at 0x6129d90 when empty), restores the estimate field to 8, zeroes counter and finished, clears last_key, and tail-jumps to the annex reset helper only when the annex is enabled; the helper zeroes the accumulator, sets enabled to 1 and clears the entries vector.
